review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR); the report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in equipment-rule-census.json. MEASURED (record and key names only; provenance static, never verified_original): through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_equipment_rule_census the sixteen catalogued weapons.zrd records declare exactly the 41 pinned top-level keys and none names a requirement or permission, so the empty equipment rule set is the measured value. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); equipment compatibility held in any other source; stack capacity, unit mass and media ids, which keep t452.limit.runtime_lowering open. The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
